items.title: Eurreal Wilford "Little Brother" Montgomery Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: I played with Clance Desdune's band.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah, he's still playing. Doing quite well. Um... You once made a tour, didn't you, with Desdune?
Yeah, well I played with Clance Desdune's band. He was out in New Orleans. Yeah.
Did you play with him in the city too? Oh, yeah.
